description: This file defines the 'Project' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mappings, and basic getter/setter methods. It encapsulates project-related data such as id, customer, name, description, deletion status, and associated project administrators.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Entity class representing a project within the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_project' database table with properties including project ID, associated customer, name, description, deletion status, and project administrators.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the project.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the project.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer entity with this project.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the project is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project as deleted or active.

methods.name: getProjectAdmins
methods.description: Returns the collection of employee project administrators.
